title: Cánh cửa khép
about: Round 24, song-tau ("1. Piano + viola: Piano chơi giai điệu thưa; viola kéo những nốt trung trầm, chỉ xuất hiện cuối câu"): E minor at 56 bpm, the slowest and sparsest (two notes a bar, many held), one soft deep note a chord, the violas only at each sentence's end; a middle section in C and G. An original tune.
